tool_arguments.query: Marvell Technology data-center revenue Q3 fiscal 2027 custom AI silicon electro-optics

events.content: Marvell Technology data-center revenue Q3 fiscal 2027 custom AI silicon electro-optics

Marvell had **not yet reported Q3 fiscal 2027 data-center revenue** as of its latest reported quarter; Q2 FY2027 ended August 1, 2026, and data-center revenue was **$2.172 billion**, up **46% year over year** and **18% sequentially**, representing **79%** of total revenue. [[1]] 

For Q3 FY2027, Marvell guided total company revenue to roughly **$3.15 billion** (±5%), while an industry analysis estimated data-center revenue would rise about **20% sequentially** and **75% year over year**; applying 20% to Q2’s $2.172 billion implies approximately **$2.61 billion** in Q3 data-center revenue. [[2]] [[1]] 

The expected Q3 step-up reflects broad data-center demand, with management specifically citing strong connectivity demand and a **significant acceleration in Custom silicon beginning in the second half of FY2027**. [[1]] 

Marvell does **not** disclose quarterly revenue separately for custom AI silicon versus electro-optics in its reported end-market table; however, its FY2026 investor materials characterize optical interconnect as roughly **half of data-center revenue** and custom silicon as approximately **25%** of data-center revenue. [[3]] 

A third-party model estimated Q2 FY2027 electro-optical-component revenue at approximately **$1.4 billion**, up **97.2% year over year**, indicating that optics remained the larger near-term AI revenue contributor even as custom silicon began to accelerate. [[2]] 

The relevant product set includes 800G and 1.6T scale-out optics, NPO/CPO scale-up optical solutions, data-center interconnect modules, and custom XPU/XPU-attach solutions. [[4]]

events.content: Marvell Technology carrier enterprise networking revenue Q2 FY2027

Marvell’s last separately reported end-market revenue was in **Q3 FY2026** (three months ended November 1, 2025): **enterprise networking revenue was $237.2 million** and **carrier-infrastructure revenue was $167.8 million**. [[1]] 

Those amounts represented **11%** and **8%**, respectively, of Marvell’s $2.075 billion total quarterly revenue. [[1]] 

Versus Q3 FY2025, enterprise networking rose **57%** from $150.9 million, while carrier infrastructure rose **98%** from $84.7 million. [[1]] 

Marvell began combining enterprise networking, carrier infrastructure, consumer, and automotive/industrial into a single **“communications and other”** end market beginning in Q4 FY2026, so subsequent filings do not provide the two requested revenue figures separately. [[1]] 

For context, in the latest reported quarter, Q2 FY2027 ended August 1, 2026, Communications and other revenue was **$567.8 million**, up 10% year over year and down 3% sequentially; this is not directly comparable to the former two-category sum because it includes the additional end markets. [[2]]

**Marvell Technology — Q4 FY2026 (quarter ended January 31, 2026)**

- Marvell reported record Q4 revenue of **$2.219 billion**, up **7% sequentially** and **22% year over year**; this was **$19 million above** the midpoint of its December guidance. [[1]]
- Q4 GAAP net income was **$396.1 million**, or **$0.46 per diluted share**, while non-GAAP net income was **$685.1 million**, or **$0.80 per diluted share**. [[1]]

- Management attributed the data-center outperformance to stronger-than-expected demand across its **interconnect** portfolio, with sequential growth in **optical interconnects/electro-optics, custom silicon, switching, and storage**. [[2]]
- Communications and other revenue was **$567.4 million**, up **2% sequentially** and **26% year over year**. [[1]]

- Marvell’s custom business generated approximately **$1.5 billion in FY2026 revenue**, roughly **doubling year over year**; FY2026 was the first full production year for the relevant custom programs. [[2]]

[[3]]

**Marvell Technology — Q1 FY2027 AI-data-center read-through** *(quarter ended May 2, 2026; results released May 27, 2026).* [[1]]

- Marvell reported record Q1 FY2027 revenue of **$2.418 billion**, up **28% year over year** and **9% sequentially**. [[2]]
- Data-center revenue was a record **$1.833 billion**, up **27% year over year** and **11% sequentially**; it represented roughly **76%** of company revenue. [[2]] [[3]]
- The remaining **communications and other** revenue was **$585.1 million**, up **29% year over year** and **3% sequentially**. [[4]] [[2]]
- Q1 profitability included a **52.1% GAAP gross margin**, **58.9% non-GAAP gross margin**, and **$0.80 non-GAAP diluted EPS**. [[5]]

**Custom AI silicon**

- Management said custom-silicon revenue remains on track to grow **more than 20% year over year in FY2027**, led by its flagship XPU program and additional XPU-attach ramps, including CXL and NIC products. [[3]]
- For FY2028, Marvell forecast custom revenue to grow **more than 100% year over year**, driven by multiple program ramps and several new custom design wins. [[2]]
- This implies the Q1 data-center performance was not dependent on a single product category: management reported sequential and annual growth across **optical interconnect, custom silicon, and switching**. [[3]]

**Electro-optics / interconnect**

- Marvell raised its FY2027 interconnect-revenue growth outlook to **more than 70% year over year**, making interconnect the principal source of the expected approximately **50% FY2027 data-center-revenue growth**. [[2]] [[3]]
- Demand cited by the company spans **800G and 1.6T scale-out optics**, **51.2T Ethernet scale-out switches**, scale-up optical solutions for **NPO/CPO**, and scale-across data-center-interconnect modules. [[4]]
- The scale-up-optics opportunity is expected to ramp strongly in FY2028, with revenue forecast to more than double versus the company’s prior **approximately $150 million** outlook. [[2]]
- Scale-out-switch revenue is forecast to exceed **$600 million in FY2027**, about double year over year, with a path to approximately **$1 billion in FY2028**. [[2]]

**Outlook and analytical takeaway**

- Marvell guided Q2 FY2027 revenue to **$2.700 billion ±5%** at the midpoint, or roughly **35% year-over-year growth**. [[4]]
